samples.summary: `Spreadsheet.focusUndoSelection` — the landing half of the cross-tab undo feature — has no test at all
samples.evidence: The new tests cover the resolver (packages/sheets/test/workbook/undo-selection.test.ts), the engine's same-tab selection application (packages/sheets/test/sheet/undo-selection.test.ts) and the store (packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store-undo.test.ts). Nothing exercises `focusUndoSelection`, which is what actually restores the selection once the host has switched tabs: grep for `focusUndoSelection` matches only spreadsheet.ts:689 and sheet-view.tsx:1454, no test file. Its row/column branches (`selectRow` + `selectRowRange`, `selectColumn` + `selectColumnRange`) and the `!selection.range` early return are entirely unverified — grep for `selectRowRange|selectColumnRange` in packages/sheets/test matches only decimals.test.ts and formatting.test.ts, unrelated. A defect here means the cross-tab undo switches tabs and then shows nothing, i.e. exactly the reported user-visible failure this change exists to fix, shipping undetected. The repo already demonstrates a cheap way to test this shape (test/view/spreadsheet-readonly-recalc.test.ts calls the prototype method against a hand-built context).

samples.summary: No test exercises the rangeStyles undo path through a real store; the resolver test fabricates patches, so the snapshot/clone/JSON-identity seam is uncovered
samples.evidence: `diffRangeStyles` (undo-selection.ts:338) compares patches by `JSON.stringify(patch)` over what `snapshotTabs` produced via `cloneRangeStylePatch` on live Yorkie proxy arrays (yorkie-store.ts:1352). The only tests for this are packages/sheets/test/workbook/undo-selection.test.ts, which hand-build plain objects cast `as any` — key ordering, extra proxy fields, or normalisation differences between a stored patch and its clone cannot be caught there. The new integration file packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store-undo.test.ts never calls `setRangeStyle`/`setRangeStyles` (grep: no `rangeStyles`/style test in that file), even though 'cell/range style change' is one of the headline rows in the defect table of docs/tasks/active/20260917-sheets-undo-selection-todo.md:28. If this seam is wrong, undoing a style change still leaves the selection put — the exact bug claimed fixed — with a green suite.

samples.summary: The `merges` operation branch of the resolver is untested at every layer
samples.evidence: collectTouches handles `case 'merges'` (undo-selection.ts:197-205) including a `parseRef` failure swallow. Grep for `merges` in packages/sheets/test/workbook/undo-selection.test.ts returns no matches, and packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store-undo.test.ts never merges or unmerges. Merge/unmerge undo selection worked before this change (per the defect table, docs/tasks/.../20260917-...md:30) and was rewritten onto the new path, so a regression there would ship silently. The `rowStyles` / `colStyles` branches and `parseAxisIndex` rejection of non-numeric keys are likewise uncovered.

samples.summary: The 'stale undoJumpTarget cleared on revision restore' fix has no test, despite the task doc asserting every review fix has one
samples.evidence: document-detail.tsx:177 adds `setUndoJumpTarget(null)` in the history-restore handler; docs/tasks/active/20260917-sheets-undo-selection-todo.md:169 states 'each has a test that fails without the fix', but grep for `handleHistoryRestored|historyResetToken` returns no test file, and no test in this diff or the tree renders DocumentLayout/SheetView with `undoJumpTarget`. Likewise the SheetView effect (sheet-view.tsx:1443-1455) — tab-id filtering and requestId dedupe — is untested, even though the frontend package does have component tests (e.g. src/components/history/__tests__/history-panel.test.tsx). Failure is contained (a stale jump after a restore) but would be user-visible and is exactly the case the author claims is covered.

samples.summary: The new `revealActiveCell()` scroll-into-view on undo/redo is not asserted anywhere
samples.evidence: spreadsheet.ts:655 and :667 add `this.worksheet.revealActiveCell()` after undo/redo, and worksheet.ts:558 adds the method. Grep for `revealActiveCell` finds only these sources, sheet-view/doc references and no test. 'Scroll it into view' is half the stated spec (docs/tasks/.../20260917-...md:6-7); if the call were dropped or the scroll no-opped, the restored selection could sit off screen and every test would still pass.

samples.summary: `pickCandidate`'s weight tie-break between two non-current tabs is untested
samples.evidence: pickCandidate (undo-selection.ts:277-283) falls back to the highest-`weight` candidate when neither tab is the current one; the workbook tests only cover current-tab preference and rank precedence (grep for `weight` in test/workbook/undo-selection.test.ts: no matches). A wrong tie-break just picks the less-changed of two other tabs — contained.

verdict.reason: No counterexample exists. Repo-wide grep for `focusUndoSelection` (excluding node_modules) matches only the implementation (packages/sheets/src/view/spreadsheet.ts:689), its doc comment, the single caller (packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/sheet-view.tsx:1454), a task doc and stale .agent-review artifacts — no test file. I also searched for indirect coverage: `UndoSelection|undoJump|undo-selection|tabJump` across all test/spec files yields only packages/sheets/test/{workbook,sheet}/undo-selection.test.ts plus two unrelated docs-package tests; `SheetView|sheet-view` in tests yields only document-detail-lakehouse-tab.test.tsx and preview-surface.test.tsx, neither mounting the `undoJumpTarget` effect (sheet-view.tsx:1443-1455). The existing engine test does not cover it transitively: Sheet.applyUndoSelection (sheet.ts:5484-5527) sets activeCell/ranges directly, whereas focusUndoSelection is an independent reimplementation via selectRow/selectRowRange/selectColumn/selectColumnRange/selectStart/selectEnd — separate code with separate failure modes. The method is testable in the style already used at test/view/spreadsheet-readonly-recalc.test.ts:24 (calling Spreadsheet.prototype against a hand-built context). This is a new user-visible behavior (the landing half of cross-tab undo) with no meaningful test, so a defect making cross-tab undo switch tabs and restore nothing would ship undetected — major under the missing-tests rubric.

finding.evidence: `diffRangeStyles` (undo-selection.ts:338) compares patches by `JSON.stringify(patch)` over what `snapshotTabs` produced via `cloneRangeStylePatch` on live Yorkie proxy arrays (yorkie-store.ts:1352). verdict.reason: Verified independently. resolveUndoSelection has exactly one production caller (yorkie-store.ts:27,1327), fed by snapshotTabs() which clones live Yorkie proxy patches via cloneRangeStylePatch (yorkie-store.ts:1352-1353); diffRangeStyles then compares them by JSON.stringify (undo-selection.ts:344-352). The only store-level test of that caller, yorkie-store-undo.test.ts (read in full, 174 lines), exercises cell overwrite, delete, batch, setDimensionSize, shiftCells insert/delete, axis growth, redo and cross-tab — and contains no style mutation at all (the store method is addRangeStyle, which does not appear in the file). The only rangeStyles coverage is undo-selection.test.ts:169-274, which hand-builds literals cast 'as any' and never goes through a store or the clone. No counterexample is reachable: MemStore.undo() has no history, so no packages/sheets test can hit the path; repo-wide grep for addRangeStyle finds only harness visual scenarios and yorkie-cross-sheet.integration.ts:157 (a remote-change path assertion with no undo() call); the hunt harness exposes only sheet.canUndo (documented as always false under MemStore) and there is no e2e suite. The gap is real and covers the headline 'cell/range style change' row of the feature being shipped: a wrong snapshot/clone/JSON-identity seam reproduces the exact bug claimed fixed while the suite stays green.
